contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Non-Surgical Rhinoplasty

Subtle Nose Enhancement, Naturally Beautiful Results

Overview

Non-Surgical Rhinoplasty is a minimally invasive aesthetic procedure designed to enhance the shape, symmetry, and overall appearance of the nose without surgery.

Using advanced injectable techniques, the treatment can help improve the appearance of minor irregularities, smooth nasal contours, and create better facial balance. It is commonly chosen by individuals seeking subtle refinements without the downtime associated with traditional surgical procedures. Treatment plans are carefully tailored to individual facial anatomy and aesthetic goals, focusing on achieving natural-looking results that complement overall facial harmony.

Key benefits

  • Visibly brighter, even-toned skin
  • Reduces pigmentation, tan & dullness
  • Tightens pores & boosts collagen
  • Zero downtime — pre-event ready
  • Customised to your skin goals

Who should opt

  • Dull, tired or pigmented skin
  • Pre-bridal & event glow
  • Anyone wanting preventative anti-ageing

The Procedure

01

Skin analysis & customised plan

02

Deep cleanse + exfoliation

03

Active boosters (vitamin C / glutathione / HA)

04

Laser toning or microneedling RF

05

Sunscreen & home-care prescription
